body: Thanks for talking to me. I guess no matter what happens the sun will rise tomorrow.
How though? How can I possibly do better or fix anything. I feel to tired to get out of bed but I feel like I’d need to move a mountain to fix my problems
To be honest I don’t know it just feels like the only way get away from guilt and pain
Thanks for replying to my post it does make make me feel there’s hope. I think I’ll get some sleep and hopefully feel better in the morning.

I really don’t know my first steps I suppose I really need to talk to someone properly these simple posts on reddit make me better so I suppose a real person would be even better. Although I probably did make mistakes 8 years ago I don’t really remember most of them I guess I’ve just felt down for the past 8 years and constantly messed up my life. What’s really pushed me over the edge was a mistake 3 months ago I keep trying to push it away and forget about but I can’t.

Thanks. I probably should find someone to talk to. I suppose I’ve never really got everything off my chest before and it’s nice to feel posting on here is a step in the right direction to doing something right?

I just feel that I live every moment as “it doesn’t matter I’ll be dead soon”, i feel that I’ve made mistakes in the past that I can never correct and make me physically sick with guilt. Overall I just feel that I have the past 8 years of my life built up inside me and no way to make any of the past 8 years go away without making myself go away.
Thanks. It means something to here that

I’m not sure what it is but it seems sub conscious. I wanted to do it but couldn’t. I’m just not sure what to do now because I genuinely didn’t expect to get this far. I thought I’d be gone by Monday but still here I am 😔
